name: linear-radar
title: Linear Radar
description: Linear issues that involve you, unseen first

triggers.label: New Linear issue for me
triggers.description: An open Linear issue newly shows up in one of your lists: assigned to you, created by you, or mentioning or subscribing you. Once a list passes 50 issues or 100 notifications, an issue older than the first sync never fires, even if it is reassigned to you or mentions you later.
